No, it's not just funny vowels.  The reason they look that way is you're
viewing them on a system that doesn't have a font in the iso-8859-8
character set installed.  You're seeing it as if the character set was
iso-8859-1, the Western European character set.  If you view it on a
system with the iso-8859-8 character set font installed properly, you'll
see that it's my name in Hebrew.  Assuming you
